title: Bounded etale witnesses for finite reduction and open extension
statement:
Fix the finite-field and coefficient datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber] and $A=A_{E,n}	o B=A_{E,m}$ with $1\le m\le n$. Let $j:X\hookrightarrow Z$ be an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion] and $K\in D^b_c(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ (bounded, with cohomology sheaves constructible in the sense of [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf]) have Tor amplitude $[a,b]$ [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. Write $S_T=-\otimes^L_AB$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings] on either site, $U_T$ for exact scalar restriction [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars], and $
u_T^*$ for the etale/pro-etale comparison [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. There is $K_e\in D^b_c(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes] with $
u_X^*K_e\cong K$. Put $E_e=j_!^{\mathrm{et},A}K_e$ [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero]. Then $K_e,E_e,S_X^{\mathrm{et}}K_e,S_Z^{\mathrm{et}}E_e$ are bounded in their respective coefficient categories. The last two have cohomology only in $[a,b]$. The canonical B-linear comparisons
$$
u_X^*S_X^{\mathrm{et}}K_e\cong S_XK,\qquad 
u_Z^*S_Z^{\mathrm{et}}E_e\cong j_!^BS_XK$$
give bounded etale-origin witnesses [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness], and $
u_Z^*E_e\cong j_!^AK$. The underlying A-complexes $K_e\otimes_A^LB$ and $E_e\otimes_A^LB$ are bounded as well.

proof.text: Apply clause (ii) of [lem-sf-proetale-constructible-origin] to the given intrinsically bounded constructible $A$-complex $K$. Choose $K_e\in D^b_c(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $\alpha:\nu_X^*K_e\cong K$. The coefficient is the finite stage $A_{E,n}$ required there; no Noetherian hypothesis on $X$ is needed.

proof.text:
Apply [lem-pur-coefficient-pullback-comparison] to the geometric inverse image $
u_X^{-1}$, the constant ring map $A	o B$, and $K_e$, and also to $
u_Z^{-1}$ and $E_e=j_!^{\mathrm{et},A}K_e$. Its derived comparisons give B-linear isomorphisms $\delta_X:
u_X^*S_X^{\mathrm{et}}K_e\cong S_X
u_X^*K_e$ and $\delta_Z:
u_Z^*S_Z^{\mathrm{et}}E_e\cong S_Z
u_Z^*E_e$. The geometric morphisms and constant-scalar lifts are [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]; their module inverse images are exact by [prop-weil-pbc-site-comparison-finite-level]. The scalar functors are the K-flat derived extensions of [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Thus this is an application to the actual ringed topoi, not a comparison merely after forgetting B-linearity. Compose $\delta_X$ with $S_X\alpha$ to obtain the first comparison in the statement.

proof.text: On either site the underlying A-complex of $S_TH$ is $H\otimes_A^LB$. Indeed choose a flat-term K-flat resolution $P\to H$ by [lem-pc-kflat-resolution]. Derived scalar extension is represented by $P\otimes_AB$ by [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]; after restriction its terms are the ordinary A-module tensors by [lem-pur-change-of-rings-tensor-comparison]. The same K-flat $P$ computes derived tensor with the degree-zero A-module B by [def-weil-derived-tensor] on the pro-etale site and [def-kun-derived-tensor] on the etale site. Scalar restriction [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars] changes only the action, hence cohomology as an abelian sheaf is unchanged. In particular apply the given Tor-amplitude condition [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude] to the A-module sheaf B on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$: $S_XK$ has cohomology only in $[a,b]$, as a B-complex as well as after restriction.

proof.text: The exact etale extension by zero of [lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-exact] commutes with cohomology, so $E_e=j_!^{\mathrm{et},A}K_e$ is bounded: $\mathcal H^q(E_e)=j_!^{\mathrm{et},A}\mathcal H^q(K_e)$. Apply [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison] degreewise. Both open extensions are exact (on the pro-etale site by [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero]), so its natural sheaf isomorphism descends to $\nu_Z^*E_e\cong j_!^A\nu_X^*K_e\cong j_!^AK$. Exactness of comparison inverse image is supplied by [prop-weil-pbc-site-comparison-finite-level].

proof.text: Compose $\delta_Z$ from step 2, scalar extension of the isomorphism of step 4, and the B-linear open comparison of [lem-fix-open-scalar-tensor-normalization]. The result is the required canonical B-linear chain of isomorphisms $\nu_Z^*S_Z^{\mathrm{et}}E_e\cong S_Zj_!^AK\cong j_!^BS_XK$. Its last term has cohomology only in $[a,b]$: by [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero], $j_!^B$ is exact and $\mathcal H^q(j_!^BS_XK)=j_!^B\mathcal H^q(S_XK)$, and step 3 gives the vanishing. This proves the asserted range on the pro-etale side without any flatness assumption on $A\to B$.

proof.text:
For $T=X,Z$ put respectively $H=S_X^{\mathrm{et}}K_e,S_Z^{\mathrm{et}}E_e$. Exactness in [prop-weil-pbc-site-comparison-finite-level] gives $\mathcal H^q(
u_T^*H)=
u_T^*\mathcal H^q(H)$: exact inverse image preserves the kernels, images and quotients defining cohomology. Steps 2--5 show that this is zero for $q
otin[a,b]$. The same cited node, now at the finite coefficient B, gives the sheaf unit $\mathcal H^q(H)\cong
u_{T,*}
u_T^*\mathcal H^q(H)=0$. Thus both etale scalar extensions have precisely the asserted vanishing range, and are bounded. By step 3 their underlying A-complexes are the two derived tensors in the statement; restriction changes no kernels or quotients, so those are bounded too. Together with bounded $K_e,E_e$ from steps 1 and 4, the displayed isomorphisms give bounded etale-origin pairs in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness].

Step 4: both j_! and nu^* are exact, so the sheaf comparison lifts termwise to D. Step 5: beta_j from the same-unit lem-fix-open-scalar-tensor-normalization (first paragraph), and exactness of j_!^B gives the [a,b] range. Step 6: the bounds are reflected to the étale side by exactness plus the unit F≅nu_*nu^*F at finite B; this is elementary, and D^+ is established before def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness is used.
